theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_spine_tangent_of_invariant_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < n → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => y + x) ⁻¹' A) = R.measure A) → (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure ((fun x => lam • x) '' A) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) * R.measure A) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection x = x ∧ ∀ v ∈ L, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection v = v
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
